scenes.text: King Tut's tomb was found just as the money was about to run out.
Howard Carter had searched Egypt's Valley of the Kings for years, paid for by Lord Carnarvon.
Carnarvon was ready to stop funding him when, on November fourth, nineteen twenty-two, a stone step turned up.
Weeks later, Carter peered into the tomb by candlelight.
Asked if he could see anything, he replied: yes, wonderful things!
The tomb held more than five thousand objects, and clearing it took about ten years.
What would you want to find in an ancient tomb?

title: King Tut's tomb was found at the last minute 🏺
caption: On Nov 4, 1922, Howard Carter's team found the first step of Tutankhamun's tomb, just as his funding was about to end. Inside were more than 5,000 objects. 🏺
